Only the part that answers the question, never a whole paragraph.
Only if the text says so, not if it seems likely.

short.q: Text: « Ma mère voulait préparer une grande fête, mais finalement on fera juste un repas en famille. » What will the family do? Explain. [2]
short.model: A family meal. The party was the original plan.

short.q: True or false? Correct if false: « Les apprentis passent tout leur temps dans une entreprise. » [2]
short.model: False. They spend part of the time in a company and the rest in a training centre.
points: Correction: partly company, partly training centre (1)

short.q: Explain how to answer a Reading question with lifting. [2]
short.model: Copy only the words that answer the question, and change je to il/elle if possible.

short.q: « Ce n'est pas la peine de prendre une serviette. » Should he bring a towel? Explain. [2]
short.model: No. They have plenty of towels.

short.q: Give three Reading strategies for unknown words. [3]
short.model: Use cognates, use word families, use context and skip words not needed.
